iomete-spark3:position-deletes:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 writes Parquet position delete files for merge-on-read DELETE, UPDATE and MERGE INTO on V2 tables, and applies position deletes written by other engines.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark3:position-deletes:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 applies position delete files on V3 tables, but writes new merge-on-read deletes on V3 tables as deletion vectors.
caveats: New V3 row-level deletes are written as deletion vectors, not position delete files

iomete-spark3:equality-deletes:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 never writes equality deletes: Spark SQL DML uses copy-on-write or position deletes (deletion vectors on V3).
caveats: Applying equality deletes written by other engines on read does not count as support

iomete-spark3:equality-deletes:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 never writes equality deletes: Spark SQL DML uses copy-on-write or position deletes (deletion vectors on V3).
caveats: Applying equality deletes written by other engines on read does not count as support

iomete-spark3:merge-on-read:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 supports merge-on-read DELETE, UPDATE and MERGE INTO, selected with write.delete.mode, write.update.mode and write.merge.mode, writing position delete files.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark3:merge-on-read:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 supports merge-on-read DELETE and UPDATE, selected with write.delete.mode, write.update.mode and write.merge.mode, writing deletion vectors (Puffin files).

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark3:copy-on-write:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 uses copy-on-write by default for DELETE, UPDATE and MERGE INTO, rewriting the affected data files.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark3:copy-on-write:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 uses copy-on-write by default for DELETE and UPDATE, rewriting the affected data files.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark3:schema-evolution:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 adds, drops, renames and reorders columns and widens types with ALTER TABLE.

iomete-spark3:schema-evolution:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 adds, drops, renames and reorders columns and widens types with ALTER TABLE.

iomete-spark3:type-promotion:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 applies Iceberg's safe type promotions (int to long, float to double, wider decimal precision) with ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE.

iomete-spark3:type-promotion:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 applies Iceberg's safe type promotions (int to long, float to double, wider decimal precision) with ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE.
caveats: The V3 date to timestamp promotion is rejected

iomete-spark3:column-default-values:v2.notes: Column default values are a V3 feature.

iomete-spark3:column-default-values:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 rejects DEFAULT column values on Iceberg tables: CREATE TABLE with a DEFAULT clause fails with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.TABLE_OPERATION, and the connector also refuses ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT.

iomete-spark3:table-creation:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 creates Iceberg tables with CREATE TABLE, CREATE TABLE AS SELECT and REPLACE TABLE AS SELECT, with the format version set in TBLPROPERTIES.

iomete-spark3:table-creation:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 creates Iceberg tables with CREATE TABLE, CREATE TABLE AS SELECT and REPLACE TABLE AS SELECT, with the format version set in TBLPROPERTIES.

iomete-spark3:hidden-partitioning:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 supports Iceberg hidden partitioning with the identity, year, month, day, hour, bucket and truncate transforms.

iomete-spark3:hidden-partitioning:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 supports Iceberg hidden partitioning with the identity, year, month, day, hour, bucket and truncate transforms.

iomete-spark3:partition-evolution:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 evolves partition specs with ALTER TABLE ... ADD, DROP and REPLACE PARTITION FIELD. IOMETE enables the Iceberg SQL extensions by default.

iomete-spark3:partition-evolution:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 evolves partition specs with ALTER TABLE ... ADD, DROP and REPLACE PARTITION FIELD. IOMETE enables the Iceberg SQL extensions by default.

iomete-spark3:multi-arg-transforms:v2.notes: Multi-argument transforms are a V3 feature.

iomete-spark3:multi-arg-transforms:v3.notes: Spark SQL cannot define multi-argument partition transforms, so IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 cannot create them.

iomete-spark3:time-travel:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 supports time travel with VERSION AS OF and TIMESTAMP AS OF in SQL, and reads branches and tags by name.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg branching, tagging and time travel

iomete-spark3:time-travel:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 supports time travel with VERSION AS OF and TIMESTAMP AS OF in SQL, and reads branches and tags by name.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg branching, tagging and time travel

iomete-spark3:table-maintenance:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 runs the Iceberg maintenance procedures: rewrite_data_files, rewrite_manifests, expire_snapshots and remove_orphan_files. IOMETE's Table Maintenance service (Beta) also runs them automatically.

iomete-spark3:table-maintenance:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 runs the Iceberg maintenance procedures: rewrite_data_files, rewrite_manifests, expire_snapshots and remove_orphan_files. IOMETE's Table Maintenance service (Beta) also runs them automatically.

iomete-spark3:branching-tagging:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 creates, replaces and drops branches and tags with the Iceberg SQL extensions, and reads and writes branches.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg branching, tagging and time travel

iomete-spark3:branching-tagging:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 creates, replaces and drops branches and tags with the Iceberg SQL extensions, and reads and writes branches.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg branching, tagging and time travel

iomete-spark3:read-support:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 reads Iceberg V2 tables, applying position deletes.

iomete-spark3:read-support:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 reads Iceberg V3 tables, applying position deletes and deletion vectors.
caveats: V3 tables with a VARIANT, GEOMETRY/GEOGRAPHY or nanosecond timestamp column cannot be read: Spark 3.5 has no such types

iomete-spark3:write-insert:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 supports INSERT INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE, DataFrameWriterV2 append and overwrite, CTAS and RTAS.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark3:write-insert:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 supports INSERT INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE, DataFrameWriterV2 append and overwrite, CTAS and RTAS.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark3:write-merge-update-delete:.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 runs MERGE INTO, UPDATE and DELETE through the Iceberg SQL extensions, in copy-on-write or merge-on-read mode.
caveats: The DataFrame mergeInto API needs Spark 4.0 or later; SQL MERGE INTO works

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark3:write-merge-update-delete:.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 runs UPDATE and DELETE on V3 tables through the Iceberg SQL extensions; MERGE INTO fails (see caveats).
caveats: MERGE INTO on V3 tables fails in IOMETE Spark 3.5.9-v1 with a ClassCastException in IOMETE's row-level security rule; UPDATE and DELETE work, and V2 tables are not affected
The DataFrame mergeInto API needs Spark 4.0 or later; SQL MERGE INTO works
Measured 2026-11-26 on IOMETE Spark 3.5.9-v1 (Iceberg 1.12.0) against IOMETE's Iceberg REST catalog

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark3:catalog-integration:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 uses IOMETE's built-in Iceberg REST catalog and connects to external Iceberg REST, AWS Glue and Nessie catalogs.

iomete-spark3:catalog-integration:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 uses IOMETE's built-in Iceberg REST catalog and connects to external Iceberg REST, AWS Glue and Nessie catalogs.

iomete-spark3:statistics:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 writes column metrics (value, null and NaN counts, lower and upper bounds) to manifests by default, and computes Puffin NDV statistics with the compute_table_stats procedure.

iomete-spark3:statistics:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 writes column metrics (value, null and NaN counts, lower and upper bounds) to manifests by default, and computes Puffin NDV statistics with the compute_table_stats procedure.

iomete-spark3:bloom-filters:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 writes Parquet bloom filters for columns enabled with write.parquet.bloom-filter-enabled.column.<name> and uses them to skip row groups.
caveats: Opt-in per column

iomete-spark3:bloom-filters:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 writes Parquet bloom filters for columns enabled with write.parquet.bloom-filter-enabled.column.<name> and uses them to skip row groups.
caveats: Opt-in per column

iomete-spark3:aws-glue-catalog:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 connects to the AWS Glue Data Catalog as an external Iceberg catalog.
caveats: Not measured on IOMETE: the suite's Glue test skips outside AWS

iomete-spark3:aws-glue-catalog:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 connects to the AWS Glue Data Catalog as an external Iceberg catalog.
caveats: Not measured on IOMETE: the suite's Glue test skips outside AWS

iomete-spark3:rest-catalog:v2.notes: IOMETE's managed catalog is an Iceberg REST catalog, and IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 also connects to external Iceberg REST catalogs.

iomete-spark3:rest-catalog:v3.notes: IOMETE's managed catalog is an Iceberg REST catalog, and IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 also connects to external Iceberg REST catalogs.

iomete-spark3:unity-catalog:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 connects to Unity Catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Not measured against Unity Catalog

iomete-spark3:unity-catalog:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 connects to Unity Catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Not measured against Unity Catalog

iomete-spark3:snowflake-horizon-catalog:.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 connects to Snowflake Horizon Catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Not measured against Snowflake Horizon Catalog

iomete-spark3:snowflake-horizon-catalog:.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 connects to Snowflake Horizon Catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Not measured against Snowflake Horizon Catalog
V3 table support depends on what Snowflake Horizon Catalog accepts

iomete-spark3:google-lakehouse:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 can reach Google's Lakehouse runtime catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Inferred from generic REST catalog support; not measured against Google Lakehouse

iomete-spark3:google-lakehouse:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 can reach Google's Lakehouse runtime catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Inferred from generic REST catalog support; not measured against Google Lakehouse

iomete-spark3:variant-type:v3.notes: Spark 3.5 has no VARIANT type, so IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 cannot create or read VARIANT columns.

iomete-spark3:shredded-variant:v2.notes: Shredded VARIANT is a V3 feature.

iomete-spark3:shredded-variant:v3.notes: Spark 3.5 has no VARIANT type, so IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 cannot write or read shredded variants.

iomete-spark3:geometry-type:v2.notes: GEOMETRY and GEOGRAPHY are V3 types.

iomete-spark3:geometry-type:v3.notes: Spark 3.5 has no geospatial types, so IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 cannot create or read GEOMETRY or GEOGRAPHY columns.

iomete-spark3:nanosecond-timestamps:v2.notes: Nanosecond timestamps are a V3 type.

iomete-spark3:nanosecond-timestamps:v3.notes: Spark has no nanosecond timestamp type, so IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 cannot create or read TIMESTAMP_NS columns.

iomete-spark3:unknown-type:v2.notes: The unknown type is a V3 type.

iomete-spark3:unknown-type:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 maps Spark's VOID (NullType) columns to the Iceberg V3 unknown type.

iomete-spark3:lineage:v2.notes: Row lineage is a V3 feature.

iomete-spark3:lineage:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 assigns V3 row lineage and exposes the _row_id and _last_updated_sequence_number metadata columns on V3 tables.

iomete-spark3:deletion-vectors:v2.notes: Deletion vectors are a V3 feature.

iomete-spark3:deletion-vectors:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 3.5.9 writes V3 binary deletion vectors (Puffin files) for merge-on-read DELETE and UPDATE, and applies them on read. It also applies deletion vectors written by IOMETE Spark 4.2.1.
caveats: Measured 2026-11-26 on IOMETE Spark 3.5.9-v1 (Iceberg 1.12.0) against IOMETE's Iceberg REST catalog; cross-version reads checked for DELETE
